title: Corn borers & Bt resistance

imageAlt: European corn borer F₂ screening workflow, from larval collection and rearing through single pairing, F₁ and F₂ families, diagnostic diet-overlay bioassays, and full-range assays.

title: Corn rootworm management
description: Evaluating management tools and the biology of western and northern corn rootworms.

imageAlt: Close-up photograph of a corn rootworm beetle.

title: Corn earworm & invasive pests
description: Studying resistance in corn earworm and monitoring risks associated with the invasive Old World bollworm, *Helicoverpa armigera*.
points: Invasive insect monitoring and risk assessment
imageAlt: Corn earworm and Old World bollworm monitoring workflow: moth collection and preservation, DNA extraction, molecular species identification, CYP337B3 resistance allele screening, sequencing, and data analysis.

title: Sustainable pest management

imageAlt: Potted corn plants and trial containers beside a corn field.

title: Resistance mechanisms
description: Characterizing the genetic, molecular, biochemical, and physiological mechanisms underlying Bt resistance
imageAlt: Research workflow connecting field problems, insect monitoring, laboratory diagnostics, biology and genomics, DNA markers, and pest and resistance management.
